limitations: A is the only strict P927 holdout; B/Batch2/C are calibration retrodictions.
Several per-class retrodictions exceed 5%; every miss and the exact residual-family value needed for closure are reported instead of being silently self-fit.
P922 is exact at its 3,803-identity frozen-codebook selection; equal per-identity apportionment is a transparent solver linearization, not a tier-level measurement.
P928 identifies one mixed-tier context. The common factor exactly closes that anchor but transfer outside the pinned local menu is not independently validated.

applicability_rules.apply_when: Identity is in the pinned 3,803-row set AND the physical option binds the frozen base-wire codebook measured by P922.
applicability_rules.prohibited: Do not add this selection-level surcharge to every d4/VQ row or bury it in a signed tier coefficient.
applicability_rules.zero_when: A regenerated option uses the intended refit codebook, or the identity is outside the pinned set.

solver_linearization.law: For each selected row in the exact pinned P922 identity set, add one per-identity surcharge vector iff the option uses the frozen base-wire codebook. Sum over selected matching rows.

applicability_rules.authoritative: Exact MIX_C_PATTERN assignment, exact 40-layer/39-Q2-eligible layer law, and pinned d4_k4096/qtip2/qtip3 verticals.
applicability_rules.outside_region: Do not claim validation for a materially different tier family, layer eligibility, or codebook regime; obtain a new mixed-tier anchor.
applicability_rules.solver_transfer: Use the context-corrected three rows only for the same eligible-layer menu and local MIX_C_PATTERN solve region; preserve the factor/source fields in every result.

grid_correction.law: For d4_k4096, qtip2_2.0117, and qtip3_3.0117 only, multiply each absolute class/global vertical by the explicit measured/predicted MIX_C_PATTERN factor. This common contextual factor is the minimum-assumption correction identified by one mixture anchor; it is not a standalone tier measurement.

p928_transfer_to_phase1_wire_c_disclosur.effect_on_reported_prediction: The named Wire-C residual family absorbs the disclosed near-pattern mismatch; no class pass is fabricated.
